target.title: fix(slack): log typing reaction errors instead of silently swallowing them
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The typing reaction (emoji) add and remove calls both silently swallow all errors via empty `.catch(() => {})` handlers. If the bot token lacks `reactions:write` scope, the configured typing reaction never appears and the operator has no way to diagnose why.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing error handling matches no known Slack error recovery pattern — `already_reacted` / `no_reaction` (handled elsewhere in the codebase) are the only expected reaction errors that warrant suppression. All other errors (missing_scope, invalid_auth, etc.) should be visible so operators can diagnose configuration issues.

## User Impact

Operators who configure a `typingReaction` emoji without realizing their token lacks `reactions:write` will now see `slack send: typing reaction failed: missing_scope` in verbose logs instead of silent failure.

## Evidence

**Existing tests still pass (84/84):**

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  84 passed (84)
```

**Live Slack proof (transient, not committed):**

With a bot token that lacks `reactions:write`, the configured typing reaction silently fails:
```
→ Before fix:  (no output — error swallowed)
→ After fix:  "slack send: typing reaction failed: missing_scope" appears in verbose logs
```

The proof is reproducible with any Slack bot token that has `reactions:read` but not `reactions:write`.

## Review
- Manually reviewed and verified
- AI-assisted: Yes
